title: checkin.c lichen_rollcall_render exceeds 2KB stack budget on x86_64-zephyr-elf
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/checkin.c:1773 lichen_rollcall_render() measures 3424 bytes of stack on the local x86_64-zephyr-elf gcc, tripping the house -Werror=stack-usage=2048 policy (lichen/zephyr/CMakeLists.txt -Wstack-usage=2048). Any local qemu_x86 twister build with CONFIG_LICHEN_CHECKIN=y (default y under LICHEN_COAP) fails to compile. CI (native_sim/native/64 host gcc) measures under the limit, so only local runs are affected. Discovered while building lichen/tests/coap_oscore_fallback (bd project-LICHEN-worker6-sncn): the suite had to set CONFIG_LICHEN_CHECKIN=n to build. Fix options: restructure rollcall_render to shrink its frame, or add a per-file -Wno-error=stack-usage= exception like the vendored Monocypher one in subsys/lichen/crypto/CMakeLists.txt. Parity evidence: HEAD worktree fails the same suites identically.
